title: Intervalized Access Sentry: Automated Cross-Region RBAC Reviews and Evidence Bundles
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers operating across multiple cloud regions require provable periodic access reviews constrained by data residency policies. Current ad-hoc access recertification runs do not account for session residency, SCIM-delivery latencies, or produce signed, timezone-aware evidence artifacts suitable for external auditors.

Goal: Build an end-to-end feature (Intervalized Access Sentry) that automatically runs periodic RBAC reviews per tenant-residency zone, incorporates SSO session residency metadata, triggers SCIM healing for stale mappings, and bundles verifiable evidence (signed manifests + change diffs) into audit-ready exports. The system should be configurable by cadence, regional scope, and reviewer groups, and integrate with the Console's compliance panel for dashboarding and downloads.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can run per-tenant access review jobs partitioned by data residency region (US/EU/APAC)
SSO session residency metadata is ingested and used to mark sessions out-of-scope for a region's review when appropriate
SCIM-driven deprovision recommendations are surfaced and optionally auto-applied with an admin-configurable grace window

Evidence bundle format: compressed zip containing reviewer decisions, list of evaluated principals, signed manifest with SHA256 checksums, timezone-normalized timestamps, and a machine-readable metadata.json
Bundles are stamped with an HSM-backed signing key (customer or Redwood-managed) and stored with retention metadata for auditors to download
Console displays per-job status, reviewer assignment, decision drift metrics, and links to the evidence bundle
Automated unit and e2e tests cover regional partitioning, SCIM retry/backoff behavior, and signing workflow
implementation_plan: Design: define bundle schema and signing flow; refine residency partitioning semantics with Privacy/Legal
Infra: small scheduler service (k8s cron + queue) that shards jobs by region and tenant; create SQS topic for review tasks
Runtime: extend existing access graph service APIs to return residency-scoped principal lists and session residency attributes
SCIM: add an outbound dedupe queue and exponential backoff for slow directories; implement a 'recommended_removal' flag on user records
Evidence: implement a bundler microservice that collects job output, computes checksums, signs bundle using vault/HSM and writes to object store with retention tags
Console: add job details page and bundle download button; expose reviewer workflow (approve/revoke/flag) and summary metrics
Telemetry: emit events for job scheduling, scim failures, signing errors, and reviewer decisions to the Compliance analytics dashboard
QA: run internal mock-audit with Legal + Security to validate evidence format and attestation wording
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: SCIM deprovisioning could incorrectly remove accounts due to eventual consistency. Mitigation: default to recommendation mode; require manual confirmation for first 2 cycles and configurable grace period
Risk: Signing key management expands attack surface. Mitigation: support customer-managed KMS keys; limit private key access with time-bound ephemeral agents and perform quarterly key rotation
Risk: Large tenants cause long-running jobs and timeouts. Mitigation: shard by tenant and region, add pagination and resume tokens, set per-shard concurrency limits
Risk: Residency misunderstanding across regions. Mitigation: add clear UI copy, and a residency simulation tool for admins to preview which principals are in-scope
